So parsing that pattern explicitly with day-first order restores correct data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}$') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s"}}
